pairs: A Canticle Psalm to the sons of Korah.
Its foundations are in the holy mountains:
diligit Dominus portas Sion super omnia tabernacula Jacob.
the Lord loves the gates of Zion above all the tabernacles of Jacob.
Glorious things are being said of you,
I will be mindful of Rahab and of Babylon knowing me.
and the people of the Ethiopians:
Will not Zion say that this man
Homo et homo natus est in ea,
and that man were born in her?
And the Most High himself has founded her.
in the writings of peoples and of leaders,
about those who have been in her.
Sicut lætantium omnium habitatio est in te.
For so the dwelling place within you is with all rejoicing.
